description: This file defines the WorkWeekAPI class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It exposes RESTful API endpoints for retrieving and updating work week configurations, including getOne and update methods, with validation and schema annotations. It interacts with the WorkWeek data entity and utilizes traits for service logic.

classes.name: WorkWeekAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to retrieve and update work week configurations within the Leave module.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific WorkWeek record by ID, returning the appropriate model based on the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for the model to be used in responses, based on the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getModelParamRule
methods.description: Provides validation rule for the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getIdFromUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts the WorkWeek ID from URL attributes.

methods.name: getIdParamRule
methods.description: Provides validation rule for the ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Combines validation rules for retrieving a single record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update a WorkWeek record with data supplied in request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating a WorkWeek record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation for delete operation is not applicable.
